title: Umbrellas models
body:
# 🎨 Umbrellas Resource Pack

This resource pack enhances the **visual experience** of the [Umbrellas datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/umbrellas).

## 📜 Features
- **7 Unique Umbrella Models**  
  - Each umbrella variant gets a detailed 3D model and texture.  
  - Works seamlessly with the Survival Umbrellas datapack.

- **Vanilla-Compatible**  
  - Does **not** require any mods.  
  - Fully compatible with singleplayer and multiplayer.

## 🙏 Credits
Special thanks to **Akulich** for the umbrella models:  
[Planet Minecraft Umbrellas](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/umbrellas/)  

Used with permission for modification and publication within Warp159's Umbrellas project.

## 📥 Installation
1. Download the `.zip` file.  
2. Place it inside your Minecraft `resourcepacks` folder.  
3. Enable it in the **Options → Resource Packs** menu.  


Enjoy enhanced visuals while staying safe from fall damage and descending slowly!
